messages:
sam-cs: FYI -- Customer MaplePay (prod tenant) reporting 503s across /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings since ~09:12 PST. Raised to P2, they have a live demo in ~30m. stacktrace attached in ticket. Can someone triage?

alerts-bot: Alert: hosted-inference:inference-pod-restarts spike (rate=18m, threshold=5m). See: https://ops-graph.internal/redwood/hosted-inference/restarts

maria-oncall: I'm on it, looking at pod restarts and recent deploys. @leo-eng-sre @kiran-eng-runtime can you watch the logs with me?

leo-eng-sre: grabbing logs now. quick check: nodename = g4-nyc-12, pods showing CrashLoopBackOff in staged pool.

kiran-eng-runtime: running `kubectl get pods -n hosted-inference -l role=inference -o wide` now. I see 4/12 pods Restarting, recent image tag v2.7.4 rolled ~08:50.

maria-oncall: paste logs from one pod: pod=inference-g4-7d9f6

I0421 09:14:02.831 1 inference_server.cpp:215] Starting inference loop
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
  what(): std::bad_alloc
[1]    23 abort (core dumped)  ./inference_runner
killed by SIGSEGV (core dumped)
[W gpu_memory_manager] GPU 0: OutOfMemory, requested 24576 MB, available 20480 MB
I0421 09:14:03.102 1 worker_manager.cpp:132] container restart (exitCode=137)
```

sam-cs: customer logs show 503 responses with body "upstream error" and request ids: rid=mp-9982xx. they also reported intermittent latency spike before full 503s.

leo-eng-sre: exitCode=137 -> OOM kill. but I also see occasional segfault lines in different pods. possibly two separate failure modes (OOM then segfault on recovery). stack traces look like GPU allocator + attention kernel.

kiran-eng-runtime: pulled dinos on node: dmesg shows: `GPU device driver: evicting process due to OOM` and `Kernel panic - stack protector: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference` in one instance. might be a driver/host kernel interaction causing container-level segfaults.

jess-product: customer is asking if this is a code change or a capacity issue — they need a short explanation for the SL.

maria-oncall: immediate mitigation proposals: 1) route MaplePay traffic to a stable older model variant (v2.6.x) / smaller instance type, 2) scale up pooled GPU nodes + cordon suspect host g4-nyc-12, 3) throttle batch sizes for that tenant via gateway. Which is fastest?

leo-eng-sre: fastest is routing to older model variant we keep as fallback (canary route). I can push a route change to send MaplePay to fallback model in 2–3 mins. Also add a per-tenant rate limit to reduce concurrent batches.

kiran-eng-runtime: I'll start cordoning the node and draining pods on g4-nyc-12 to stop noisy restarts: `kubectl cordon g4-nyc-12 && kubectl drain g4-nyc-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. After draining, observe if restarts stop.

maria-oncall: go for it. Also disable autoscaler scale-in for the pool to avoid churn.

(5m later)

leo-eng-sre: Route change deployed: MaplePay -> model:redwood-small-2023-06-fallback. Confirmed 5 of 6 customer requests now 200. latency stabilized to 110ms median. :thumbsup:

alerts-bot: Alert cleared: hosted-inference:inference-pod-restarts spike normalized.

kiran-eng-runtime: Node cordoned/drained. The pods on g4-nyc-12 show crash frequency dropping. However, a few other nodes show similar OOM patterns under peak concurrent batches.

sam-cs: Customer confirmed demo continues, they asked for root cause and timeline. They also asked about whether this will recur.

leo-eng-sre: preliminary RCA: v2.7.4 changed attention kernel memory prefetching which increases per-request GPU memory for long contexts. Under a certain concurrency and batch config our allocator sometimes fails -> container OOM -> restart -> rare segfault during restore of CUDA contexts on some driver versions, causing SIGSEGV. Combined with tight node packing this resulted in a spike.

kiran-eng-runtime: repro steps we used in staging:
1) deploy v2.7.4 inference image
2) send concurrent requests 16x with seq_len=2048 and batch_size=8 using our load generator
3) observe allocator exceeding per-gpu available memory and OOMKills in container logs

We also repro'd the segfault on a dev host with nvidia-driver 530.41.03, but not on 525.x.

maria-oncall: short-term remediation: rollback v2.7.4 rollout to v2.6.12 for hosted pool; add per-tenant concurrency guard and default batch_size cap (4) for tenants above free tier; add node-level driver compatibility label and avoid scheduling new pods on drivers >=530 until we get a fix.

leo-eng-sre: agreed. I'll start a rollback to v2.6.12 in the hosted pool and open a ticket with our runtime team to revert the prefetch change. Will also add the alert: `increase in OOMKilled || pod_restarts > 3 in 5m` -> P1.

kiran-eng-runtime: Followups for infra: 1) test v2.7.4 with patched allocator in staging with driver 530 to confirm, 2) backport memory-safety checks to runtime, 3) ensure we pin CUDA driver matrix in CI, 4) add crash-loop rate limiter in the scheduler to avoid mass restarts.

jess-product: I'll update customer comms template: timeline, short cause, mitigation, ETA for fix (we'll say ~24-48h to triage and test).

maria-oncall: Actions logged: INC-2026 MaplePay 503s -> assigned to leo-eng-sre & kiran-eng-runtime. Rollback in progress. Watch channel for deploy completion.

(30m later)

leo-eng-sre: rollback complete, traffic back to stable images for hosted pool. Monitoring shows backend CPU/GPU memory pressure normalizing. Will keep MaplePay pinned to fallback for 24h while we validate.

sam-cs: Customer updated, they appreciate the quick response. Marking incident as mitigated. Please follow through on follow-ups.

maria-oncall: Leaving notes for postmortem: include timeline, logs (attached), per-tenant batching guard added, scheduler crash-loop backoff implemented. Root cause hypothesis: increased kernel memory prefetching + certain driver versions -> OOM -> segfault during recovery. Next: repro fix, runtime patch, and driver matrix pinned in CI.

leo-eng-sre: filing postmortem and linking it here when ready. Also adding a short runbook entry: "If hosted inference 503 spike -> check pod_restarts alert -> cordon node -> route affected tenant to fallback model -> rollback build if new image".

kiran-eng-runtime: note: please collect `kubectl get events -n hosted-inference --sort-by='.lastTimestamp'` and attach to the postmortem.

sam-cs: thanks all. Closing thread after PM published. :pray:
